title: Debit-order collections rejected for contracts with collection day 31
symptom: Bank rejected the September run for contracts whose collection day did not exist in the month; premiums missed.
root: BRULE-008 allowed 1-31 for recurring monthly methods.
residual: Contracts captured before the fix still carry days 29-31.

title: Activation fails with NB-REPO-423 when two supervisors approve at once
symptom: Second activation of the same contract returns a lock conflict instead of the idempotent no-op.
root: EXCLUSIVE-LOCK NO-WAIT in DbContractRepository raises before Contract:Activate() idempotency guard is reached.

title: Activation rejected as stale after broker re-captured mobile number
symptom: Supervisor could not activate; validation reported stale although nothing material changed.
root: Any mutation after Validate() bumps LastMutatedDate (Edge Case 47). Working as designed, but not explained in UI.

title: Finance import failed on nightly contract-status CSV
symptom: Nightly CSV gained owner and collection columns; downstream import rejected the file.
root: ttContractStatus.i layout changed in NBJ-133 without notifying consumers.
residual: No contract test on the CSV layout.

title: Contract linked to campaign that expired between capture and activation
symptom: Contract activated on a campaign whose EndDate passed after linking.
root: Campaign validity is checked when linking and in CampaignRequiredRule, but only against today's date at validation time; validation ran the day before expiry.
